name: seat-switch-line-card-with-dual-ejector-levers
title: Seat a switch line card by swinging dual ejector levers closed into chassis catches
instruction: Seat the switch line card: swing both ejector levers closed into their catches and release.
context: Enterprise network administrators and data center technicians install modular switch blades into 19-inch racks. Inserting a 4.0 kg card into backplane sockets requires swinging dual mechanical cam ejector handles shut symmetrically to overcome 80 N insertion force without bending pins, then engaging locking detents.
setup: 1U switch chassis slot fixed to table (face at x 33 cm, centered y 0 cm, floor 1 cm above table, 40.3 cm between guide walls, 52 cm deep). Two 8 mm steel ejector pins stand on floor tabs at x 30.17 cm, y +-20.5 cm. Two backplane connector blocks at y +-15 cm mate over final 8 mm against 5000 N/m springs (40 N each, 80 N total at home). 4.0 kg rigid line card blade (40 x 46 x 3.5 cm) starts pulled out 6 cm in guide tracks. Dual cam ejector levers pivot at y +-19.2 cm, starting 85 deg open with claws inside chassis pins. Spring catches engage when levers reach <= 2.5 deg of closed.
scoring: Each end gap: distance faceplate is short of home (18 cm either side of middle). Permanent 0.0 if differential skew > 1.5 mm while mating (gaps <= 8 mm). Stage 0.25: card pushed to pins (gaps <= 25 mm). Stage 0.50: levers rotated >= 45 deg into mating zone (gaps <= 8 mm, skew <= 1.5 mm). Stage 0.75: levers locked into catches (angle <= 2.5 deg, gaps <= 1.0 mm). Stage 1.00: hands clear > 30 mm and card withstands 20 N retention proof pull held for 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Press handle release catches, swing both ejector levers open to 85 deg, and slide card blade forward to 6 cm short of home.
fidelity: 1U switch chassis with IEEE 1101.10 guide tracks and flange pins; 4.0 kg card blade with dual pivoting cam ejector levers and detent catches; dual connector blocks with 80 N mating resistance over final 8 mm; 1.5 mm skew threshold; 20 N retention proof pull.
scores: 0.25: card pushed into pin engagement (gap<=25mm); 0.50: levers swung >=45 deg into mating zone (gap<=8mm, skew<=1.5mm); 0.75: levers locked in catches (angle<=2.5 deg, gap<=1.0mm); 1.0: hands clear and 20N retention proof pull holds for 1.0s.
run_limit: 1200 steps (60 s at 20 Hz). Scripted demo completes in ~450 steps.
